contracts.semantic_scope: one bounded securities-disposal operation tax model
one complete bounded securities category for one tax period
one complete bounded securities-derived income-group tax base

component_inventory.rule: A bounded contract may be cited only as published_bounded; use missing when no listed contract belongs to the expected semantic family.

coverage_rule: Every reviewed obligation is mandatory package inventory and must be referenced exactly once by a candidate domain; no missing, duplicate, unknown or empty obligation group is eligible for review.

evidence_policy_definitions.meaning: The Definition itself makes the obligation applicable; negative applicability evidence is forbidden.
Occurrence facts or a validated component establish applicability; exact authenticated negative attestation or exhaustive coverage is usable only when explicitly allowlisted and unconflicted.
A reviewed published typed classification over authoritative inputs decides applicability; a declarant denial is not decision authority.
An authenticated filing election establishes applicability and an authenticated non-election can close scope; eligibility and value remain typed component concerns.
Only an exact period-and-domain coverage receipt can establish absence; declarant denial alone is forbidden.

surface_requirements.semantic_requirement: Every declaration identifies the filing instance and correction, tax period, destination authority, taxpayer and period-relevant taxpayer status, and the signer or representative with supporting authority where representation is used.
Every declaration states the declaration-level tax disposition, including budget allocation meanings for tax payable, additional payment, reduction or refund.
A taxpayer may elect disposal of an established refundable amount and, for a bank refund, provide destination-account semantics.
Every declaration contains a non-empty set of applicable income-group tax-base and tax-settlement results, with a separate coherent calculation for each income group.
When relevant, the declaration accounts for taxable income from sources in the Russian Federation and its source, income-kind and tax-agent semantics.
When relevant, the declaration accounts for taxable income from sources outside the Russian Federation, source jurisdiction and foreign-tax-credit semantics.

When relevant, the declaration accounts for entrepreneurial, advocate, notarial or other private-practice income, expenses and advances; it also accounts for professional deduction claims under Tax Code article 221 paragraphs 2 and 3, including civil-contract and author or creator remuneration claims.
When relevant, the declaration accounts for income legally exempt from taxation and amounts within or above applicable exemption limits.
When claimed, the declaration accounts for standard, social, investment and long-term-savings deduction families and their eligible amounts.
When relevant, the declaration accounts for property, vehicle, rights or gift disposition income and related deductions or expense reductions.
When claimed, the declaration accounts for property acquisition, construction and related interest deduction semantics.
When relevant, the declaration accounts for securities, derivatives, digital financial assets or rights, investment-partnership and related loss or deduction semantics.
When relevant, property-disposition semantics include object-level proceeds, basis, deduction and taxable-result calculations needed by the declaration.
When relevant, social and investment deduction semantics include eligible expense categories and limit calculations needed by the declaration.

reviewed_semantic_obligations.semantic_requirement: Identify the declaration filing instance, correction state, tax period and destination tax authority.
Identify the taxpayer and the taxpayer status relevant to the declared period.
Identify the signer and, when a representative signs, retain the supporting representation authority.
Represent the declaration-level disposition of the resulting amount among payment, additional payment, reduction, refund and budget allocation meanings.
Represent a non-empty complete set of tax-base results for every income group applicable to the declaration.
Represent the tax-settlement result coherently paired with every applicable income-group tax base.
Represent the authenticated election for disposal of an established refundable amount and its destination semantics.
Represent taxable income arising from sources in the Russian Federation together with source, income-kind and relevant tax-agent facts.
Represent taxable income arising outside the Russian Federation together with source jurisdiction and authoritative foreign-tax facts relevant to credit treatment.
Represent income, associated expenses and advance payments legally classified to entrepreneurial, advocate, notarial or other private-practice activity.
Represent an authenticated professional-deduction claim for qualifying civil-law contract work or services.
Represent an authenticated professional-deduction claim for qualifying author or creator remuneration.
Represent income legally classified as exempt and the amounts within or above the applicable exemption limits.
Represent authenticated standard-deduction claims and their established eligible amounts.
Represent authenticated social-deduction claims, eligible expense categories, eligible amounts and applicable limit results.
Represent authenticated investment-deduction claims, eligible categories, eligible amounts and applicable limit results.
Represent authenticated long-term-savings deduction claims and their established eligible amounts.
Represent legally classified property or rights dispositions with object-level proceeds, basis, deduction or expense reduction and taxable-result semantics.
Represent legally classified vehicle dispositions with object-level proceeds, basis, deduction or expense reduction and taxable-result semantics.
Represent gift income requiring legal classification and its relevant taxable-result semantics.
Represent an authenticated deduction claim for qualifying property acquisition or construction and its established eligible amounts.
Represent an authenticated deduction claim for qualifying interest related to property acquisition or construction and its established eligible amounts.
Represent results legally classified to securities and derivatives, including related losses or deduction treatment.
Represent results legally classified to digital financial assets or digital rights, including related losses or deduction treatment.
Represent results legally classified to investment-partnership participation, including related losses or deduction treatment.
